    budget = case['budget']
    names = [s['name'] for s in segments]

    caps = [s['capacity'] for s in segments]
    importances = [s['importance'] for s in segments]

    total_cap = sum(caps)

        raise ValueError("Infeasible budget")

    alloc = min_alloc[:]  # copy
    remaining = budget - total_min

    while remaining > 0:
        best_idx = -1
        best_val = -1.0  # negative
        for i, (imp, cap, cur) in enumerate(zip(importances, caps, alloc)):
            if cur >= cap:

                best_idx = i
            # tie: if val == best_val, keep earlier index (i < best_idx) so no update needed
        if best_idx == -1:
            # should not happen because remaining > 0 and total_cap >= budget, so some capacity left
            raise RuntimeError("Unexpected: no eligible segment")
        alloc[best_idx] += 1
        remaining -= 1

    total = sum(alloc)
    by_name = {name: alloc[i] for i, name in enumerate(names)}
    return {"allocations": alloc, "by_name": by_name, "total": total}
